verifier_epoch.failure_token: Locator.fill attempted on role=group Slate date wrapper
verifier_epoch.first_broken_arrow: Public V239/V85 PASS -> Slate date verifier interaction FAIL
verifier_epoch.root_cause: Current Streamlit exposes Slate date as a labelled role=group with segmented editable controls; the verifier treated the wrapper itself as a fillable input.
verifier_epoch.patch: Verifier-only: descend into a real input when present, otherwise fill the three date spinbutton segments inside the labelled Slate date group.

verifier_epoch_matchup.first_broken_arrow: Slate date commit PASS -> matchup verifier targeting FAIL
verifier_epoch_matchup.root_cause: Verifier selected the matchup by combobox ordinal; frozen V46 exposes a stable accessible label 'Matchup • {N} verified games'.
verifier_epoch_matchup.patch: Verifier-only: target the V46 matchup combobox by its accessible label pattern and select the Atlanta Falcons option.

matchup_diagnostic_epoch.diagnostic_goal: Distinguish whether the segmented Slate date edit failed to commit to Streamlit state versus whether the matchup control exists under an unexpected DOM/accessibility identity.
matchup_diagnostic_epoch.external_schedule_proof: NFL official 2026 schedule confirms Atlanta Falcons at Green Bay Packers on 2026-09-24.

date_commit_epoch.first_broken_arrow: Date keystrokes completed -> V46 matchup control never appeared
date_commit_epoch.root_cause: Verifier treated segmented React Aria date edits as committed without forcing blur/Tab and waiting for the Streamlit rerun boundary.
date_commit_epoch.patch: Verifier-only: keyboard-edit each date segment, Tab/blur each segment, then wait for V46 matchup selector or explicit no-games state before declaring date GREEN.

date_segment_convergence_epoch.root_cause: Text typing into React-Aria spinbutton date segments produced partial/truncated values. The app correctly showed no verified games for the malformed date.
date_segment_convergence_epoch.patch: Verifier-only: converge month/day/year via aria-valuenow with ArrowUp/ArrowDown, reacquiring each segment after every key, then blur once and require the V46 matchup control.

regex_epoch.root_cause: Verifier over-escaped the digit regex and failed to parse a valid aria segment value of 2026.
regex_epoch.patch: Verifier-only: correct the regex from a literal backslash-d match to the intended digit matcher.

semantic_date_epoch.root_cause: Verifier assumed DOM segment order month/day/year. Prior evidence showed segment 0 carried value 2026, proving DOM order differs from visual order.
semantic_date_epoch.patch: Verifier-only: identify year/month/day segments by aria-label, with aria-valuemax fallback, then converge each semantic segment to 2026-09-24.

frame_ownership_epoch.first_broken_arrow: V85 proven -> verifier resolves V46 Slate date owner frame -> FAIL
frame_ownership_epoch.root_cause: Generic app_frame() can return a valid shell frame that does not own the V85/V46 Passing Yards control deck after Streamlit reruns.
frame_ownership_epoch.patch: Verifier-only: bind date/matchup work to passing_frame() selected by the V85 owner marker, require the V46 deck, and reacquire owner/deck/date semantic state after every rerun-producing action.
